Ferro-nickel, including nickel pig iron declared as ferro-nickel (HS 720260), 2024 (CEPII BACI): world 10.09 Mt gross weight; top exporters IDN 9.39 Mt, NCL 0.18 Mt, BRA 0.17 Mt.
Trade tables are nickel ores and concentrates in gross weight (Mt); production and reserves are contained nickel (kt Ni).

The ore tables mix two products: laterite ore, 51.8 Mt in 2024 at 48 USD per tonne on average (by unit value, flows under 300 USD per tonne), and sulphide concentrate, 1.08 Mt at 2,257 USD per tonne. A low unit value is normal for laterite ore, so no ore flow is flagged for it.
